support.headline: extrapolated (G1 size): x1.24 from the 12.7 mm row
support.detail: scaled x1.24 from the 12.7 mm row by the generic size law d^0.61; valid 0.5-2x of the row (6.350-25.400 mm); flat-end vendors spread x0.80-1.56 at 2x (x0.89-1.25 at this size)

plunge.headline: Plunge: no source; repo rule material base 2163 mm/min, Z axis rate 2500 mm/min (flat end mill 18.0 mm is outside 3.0-12.7 mm)
plunge.detail: The rule: material base 1000/h (wood), 900/h (plywood, sheet) at 6 mm, x clamp(D/6, 0.25, 3), h = (Janka/600)^0.4 (a port of the Shapeoko reference calculator). The flat end mill rule g10_plunge_flat covers 3.0-12.7 mm only; this tool is 18.0 mm. The vertical rate: the machine Z axis rate ($112) caps the vertical rate at 2500 mm/min. The engine does not read the cut direction: a down-cut or compression tool must ramp, not plunge (Vortex, AXYZ, grade c; ruling Q12, future work).

ramp.headline: ramp chip: none; the ramp holds its vertical rate at the plunge
ramp.detail: No G6 drill claim covers a 18 mm 2-flute flat end mill (the claim covers the Amana Spektra flat end mill, 3.0-12.7 mm, 2 or 3 flutes, in wood, plywood and MDF), so the ramp holds its vertical rate at the plunge.

support.headline: extrapolated (G1 size): x1.24 from the 12.7 mm row
support.detail: scaled x1.24 from the 12.7 mm row by the generic size law d^0.61; valid 0.5-2x of the row (6.350-25.400 mm); flat-end vendors spread x0.80-1.56 at 2x (x0.89-1.25 at this size)

plunge.headline: Plunge: no source; repo rule material base 2163 mm/min, Z axis rate 2500 mm/min (flat end mill 18.0 mm is outside 3.0-12.7 mm)
plunge.detail: The rule: material base 1000/h (wood), 900/h (plywood, sheet) at 6 mm, x clamp(D/6, 0.25, 3), h = (Janka/600)^0.4 (a port of the Shapeoko reference calculator). The flat end mill rule g10_plunge_flat covers 3.0-12.7 mm only; this tool is 18.0 mm. The vertical rate: the machine Z axis rate ($112) caps the vertical rate at 2500 mm/min. The engine does not read the cut direction: a down-cut or compression tool must ramp, not plunge (Vortex, AXYZ, grade c; ruling Q12, future work).

ramp.headline: ramp chip: none; the ramp holds its vertical rate at the plunge
ramp.detail: No G6 drill claim covers a 18 mm 2-flute flat end mill (the claim covers the Amana Spektra flat end mill, 3.0-12.7 mm, 2 or 3 flutes, in wood, plywood and MDF), so the ramp holds its vertical rate at the plunge.

plunge.headline: Plunge = min(feed / 2, 0.0635 x rpm x 2, Z axis rate 2500 mm/min) (G10 plunge claim: flat end mill, Amana Spektra rule; Sienci, IDC, 3.0-12.7 mm, 2-3 flutes)
plunge.detail: plunge = fraction x shipped side feed; the fraction is the printed plunge / feed of the family; rule g10_plunge_flat (rulings Q4 and Q5, 2026-09-25): x0.500 at 2 flutes; witnesses: Amana Spektra Spiral Plunge chart v24 rule and cells (Ramp Down = feed / flutes; the G6-verified cells set the range); Sienci metric chart, 60 flat rows at 0.500-0.505; IDC Woodcraft up-cut 1/8 and 1/4 in at 0.50; Carbide 3D S3 chart, median 0.49; statements g10-wood-amana-spektra-rule, g10-wood-amana-spektra-2f-quarter, g10-wood-amana-spektra-3f-quarter, g10-wood-amana-spektra-3f-3-4, g10-hobby-036..038, g10-hobby-040..042, g10-hobby-044..047, g10-hobby-051..053, g10-hobby-055..057, g10-hobby-059..062, g10-hobby-066..068, g10-hobby-070..072, g10-hobby-074..077, g10-hobby-089..091, g10-hobby-093..095, g10-hobby-097..100, g10-hobby-104..106, g10-hobby-108..110, g10-hobby-112..115, g10-hobby-119..121, g10-hobby-123..125, g10-hobby-127..130, g10-wood-idc-up-eighth, g10-wood-idc-up-quarter, g10-hobby-134..138; spread: IDC down-cut 0.30 and 0.43 (g10-wood-idc-down-eighth, g10-wood-idc-down-quarter); Carbide 3D Nomad 0.24-0.44 (g10-hobby-139..143); valid 3.0-12.7 mm, 2-3 flutes, in softwood, hardwood, plywood and MDF; two or more witnesses; Amana Ramp Down is the vertical (Z) rate (ruling Q3); ruling Q4 reads it as feed / Z; vertical rate: G6 axial chip 0.0635 mm/tooth x rpm x 2 (row amana-flat-hardwood-pocket-6000-2f-spektra); the machine Z axis rate ($112) caps the vertical rate at 2500 mm/min. The engine does not read the cut direction: a down-cut or compression tool must ramp, not plunge (Vortex, AXYZ, grade c; ruling Q12, future work).

ramp.headline: ramp chip (G6 drill claim): 0.0635 mm/tooth axial
ramp.detail: vendor row, plunge claim (G6 drill): the side chip of the pocket row / 2 flutes (x0.50); row amana-flat-hardwood-pocket-6000-2f-spektra (amana_spektra_spiral_plunge_v24); Amana prints Ramp Down = feed rate / flutes at one RPM: axial chip per tooth = side chip / Z; the ramp reads the chip at the shipped RPM; ramp feed = min(cut feed, axial chip x RPM x Z / tan θ); tan θ is conservative against sin θ

entries.headline: Ramp feed 6096 mm/min: the cut feed (chip limit 58159 mm/min at ramp 3.00°)

plunge.detail: plunge = fraction x shipped side feed; the fraction is the printed plunge / feed of the family; rule g10_plunge_flat (rulings Q4 and Q5, 2026-09-25): x0.500 at 2 flutes; witnesses: Amana Spektra Spiral Plunge chart v24 rule and cells (Ramp Down = feed / flutes; the G6-verified cells set the range); Sienci metric chart, 60 flat rows at 0.500-0.505; IDC Woodcraft up-cut 1/8 and 1/4 in at 0.50; Carbide 3D S3 chart, median 0.49; statements g10-wood-amana-spektra-rule, g10-wood-amana-spektra-2f-quarter, g10-wood-amana-spektra-3f-quarter, g10-wood-amana-spektra-3f-3-4, g10-hobby-036..038, g10-hobby-040..042, g10-hobby-044..047, g10-hobby-051..053, g10-hobby-055..057, g10-hobby-059..062, g10-hobby-066..068, g10-hobby-070..072, g10-hobby-074..077, g10-hobby-089..091, g10-hobby-093..095, g10-hobby-097..100, g10-hobby-104..106, g10-hobby-108..110, g10-hobby-112..115, g10-hobby-119..121, g10-hobby-123..125, g10-hobby-127..130, g10-wood-idc-up-eighth, g10-wood-idc-up-quarter, g10-hobby-134..138; spread: IDC down-cut 0.30 and 0.43 (g10-wood-idc-down-eighth, g10-wood-idc-down-quarter); Carbide 3D Nomad 0.24-0.44 (g10-hobby-139..143); valid 3.0-12.7 mm, 2-3 flutes, in softwood, hardwood, plywood and MDF; two or more witnesses; Amana Ramp Down is the vertical (Z) rate (ruling Q3); ruling Q4 reads it as feed / Z; vertical rate: G6 axial chip 0.0635 mm/tooth x rpm x 2 (row amana-flat-hardwood-pocket-6000-2f-spektra); the machine Z axis rate ($112) caps the vertical rate at 2500 mm/min. The engine does not read the cut direction: a down-cut or compression tool must ramp, not plunge (Vortex, AXYZ, grade c; ruling Q12, future work).

plunge.headline: Plunge: no source; repo rule material base 240 mm/min, Z axis rate 2500 mm/min (flat end mill 2.0 mm is outside 3.0-12.7 mm)
plunge.detail: The rule: material base 1000/h (wood), 900/h (plywood, sheet) at 6 mm, x clamp(D/6, 0.25, 3), h = (Janka/600)^0.4 (a port of the Shapeoko reference calculator). The flat end mill rule g10_plunge_flat covers 3.0-12.7 mm only; this tool is 2.0 mm. The vertical rate: the machine Z axis rate ($112) caps the vertical rate at 2500 mm/min. The engine does not read the cut direction: a down-cut or compression tool must ramp, not plunge (Vortex, AXYZ, grade c; ruling Q12, future work).

ramp.headline: ramp chip: none; the ramp holds its vertical rate at the plunge
ramp.detail: No G6 drill claim covers a 2 mm 1-flute flat end mill (the claim covers the Amana Spektra flat end mill, 3.0-12.7 mm, 2 or 3 flutes, in wood, plywood and MDF), so the ramp holds its vertical rate at the plunge.

plunge.headline: Plunge: no source; repo rule material base 240 mm/min, Z axis rate 2500 mm/min (flat end mill 2.0 mm is outside 3.0-12.7 mm)
plunge.detail: The rule: material base 1000/h (wood), 900/h (plywood, sheet) at 6 mm, x clamp(D/6, 0.25, 3), h = (Janka/600)^0.4 (a port of the Shapeoko reference calculator). The flat end mill rule g10_plunge_flat covers 3.0-12.7 mm only; this tool is 2.0 mm. The vertical rate: the machine Z axis rate ($112) caps the vertical rate at 2500 mm/min. The engine does not read the cut direction: a down-cut or compression tool must ramp, not plunge (Vortex, AXYZ, grade c; ruling Q12, future work).

ramp.headline: ramp chip: none; the ramp holds its vertical rate at the plunge
ramp.detail: No G6 drill claim covers a 2 mm 1-flute flat end mill (the claim covers the Amana Spektra flat end mill, 3.0-12.7 mm, 2 or 3 flutes, in wood, plywood and MDF), so the ramp holds its vertical rate at the plunge.

plunge.headline: Plunge: no source; repo rule material base 240 mm/min, Z axis rate 2500 mm/min (flat end mill 2.0 mm is outside 3.0-12.7 mm)
plunge.detail: The rule: material base 1000/h (wood), 900/h (plywood, sheet) at 6 mm, x clamp(D/6, 0.25, 3), h = (Janka/600)^0.4 (a port of the Shapeoko reference calculator). The flat end mill rule g10_plunge_flat covers 3.0-12.7 mm only; this tool is 2.0 mm. The vertical rate: the machine Z axis rate ($112) caps the vertical rate at 2500 mm/min. The engine does not read the cut direction: a down-cut or compression tool must ramp, not plunge (Vortex, AXYZ, grade c; ruling Q12, future work).

ramp.headline: ramp chip: none; the ramp holds its vertical rate at the plunge
ramp.detail: No G6 drill claim covers a 2 mm 1-flute flat end mill (the claim covers the Amana Spektra flat end mill, 3.0-12.7 mm, 2 or 3 flutes, in wood, plywood and MDF), so the ramp holds its vertical rate at the plunge.

support.headline: extrapolated (G1 size): x1.24 from the 12.7 mm row
support.detail: scaled x1.24 from the 12.7 mm row by the generic size law d^0.61; valid 0.5-2x of the row (6.350-25.400 mm); flat-end vendors spread x0.80-1.56 at 2x (x0.89-1.25 at this size)

plunge.headline: Plunge: no source; repo rule material base 2163 mm/min, Z axis rate 2500 mm/min (flat end mill 18.0 mm is outside 3.0-12.7 mm)
plunge.detail: The rule: material base 1000/h (wood), 900/h (plywood, sheet) at 6 mm, x clamp(D/6, 0.25, 3), h = (Janka/600)^0.4 (a port of the Shapeoko reference calculator). The flat end mill rule g10_plunge_flat covers 3.0-12.7 mm only; this tool is 18.0 mm. The vertical rate: the machine Z axis rate ($112) caps the vertical rate at 2500 mm/min. The engine does not read the cut direction: a down-cut or compression tool must ramp, not plunge (Vortex, AXYZ, grade c; ruling Q12, future work).

ramp.headline: ramp chip: none; the ramp holds its vertical rate at the plunge
ramp.detail: No G6 drill claim covers a 18 mm 2-flute flat end mill (the claim covers the Amana Spektra flat end mill, 3.0-12.7 mm, 2 or 3 flutes, in wood, plywood and MDF), so the ramp holds its vertical rate at the plunge.

support.headline: extrapolated (G1 size): x1.24 from the 12.7 mm row
support.detail: scaled x1.24 from the 12.7 mm row by the generic size law d^0.61; valid 0.5-2x of the row (6.350-25.400 mm); flat-end vendors spread x0.80-1.56 at 2x (x0.89-1.25 at this size)

plunge.headline: Plunge: no source; repo rule material base 2163 mm/min, Z axis rate 2500 mm/min (flat end mill 18.0 mm is outside 3.0-12.7 mm)
plunge.detail: The rule: material base 1000/h (wood), 900/h (plywood, sheet) at 6 mm, x clamp(D/6, 0.25, 3), h = (Janka/600)^0.4 (a port of the Shapeoko reference calculator). The flat end mill rule g10_plunge_flat covers 3.0-12.7 mm only; this tool is 18.0 mm. The vertical rate: the machine Z axis rate ($112) caps the vertical rate at 2500 mm/min. The engine does not read the cut direction: a down-cut or compression tool must ramp, not plunge (Vortex, AXYZ, grade c; ruling Q12, future work).

ramp.headline: ramp chip: none; the ramp holds its vertical rate at the plunge
ramp.detail: No G6 drill claim covers a 18 mm 2-flute flat end mill (the claim covers the Amana Spektra flat end mill, 3.0-12.7 mm, 2 or 3 flutes, in wood, plywood and MDF), so the ramp holds its vertical rate at the plunge.

plunge.headline: Plunge = min(feed / 2, 0.0635 x rpm x 2, Z axis rate 2500 mm/min) (G10 plunge claim: flat end mill, Amana Spektra rule; Sienci, IDC, 3.0-12.7 mm, 2-3 flutes)
plunge.detail: plunge = fraction x shipped side feed; the fraction is the printed plunge / feed of the family; rule g10_plunge_flat (rulings Q4 and Q5, 2026-09-25): x0.500 at 2 flutes; witnesses: Amana Spektra Spiral Plunge chart v24 rule and cells (Ramp Down = feed / flutes; the G6-verified cells set the range); Sienci metric chart, 60 flat rows at 0.500-0.505; IDC Woodcraft up-cut 1/8 and 1/4 in at 0.50; Carbide 3D S3 chart, median 0.49; statements g10-wood-amana-spektra-rule, g10-wood-amana-spektra-2f-quarter, g10-wood-amana-spektra-3f-quarter, g10-wood-amana-spektra-3f-3-4, g10-hobby-036..038, g10-hobby-040..042, g10-hobby-044..047, g10-hobby-051..053, g10-hobby-055..057, g10-hobby-059..062, g10-hobby-066..068, g10-hobby-070..072, g10-hobby-074..077, g10-hobby-089..091, g10-hobby-093..095, g10-hobby-097..100, g10-hobby-104..106, g10-hobby-108..110, g10-hobby-112..115, g10-hobby-119..121, g10-hobby-123..125, g10-hobby-127..130, g10-wood-idc-up-eighth, g10-wood-idc-up-quarter, g10-hobby-134..138; spread: IDC down-cut 0.30 and 0.43 (g10-wood-idc-down-eighth, g10-wood-idc-down-quarter); Carbide 3D Nomad 0.24-0.44 (g10-hobby-139..143); valid 3.0-12.7 mm, 2-3 flutes, in softwood, hardwood, plywood and MDF; two or more witnesses; Amana Ramp Down is the vertical (Z) rate (ruling Q3); ruling Q4 reads it as feed / Z; vertical rate: G6 axial chip 0.0635 mm/tooth x rpm x 2 (row amana-flat-hardwood-pocket-6000-2f-spektra); the machine Z axis rate ($112) caps the vertical rate at 2500 mm/min. The engine does not read the cut direction: a down-cut or compression tool must ramp, not plunge (Vortex, AXYZ, grade c; ruling Q12, future work).

ramp.headline: ramp chip (G6 drill claim): 0.0635 mm/tooth axial
ramp.detail: vendor row, plunge claim (G6 drill): the side chip of the pocket row / 2 flutes (x0.50); row amana-flat-hardwood-pocket-6000-2f-spektra (amana_spektra_spiral_plunge_v24); Amana prints Ramp Down = feed rate / flutes at one RPM: axial chip per tooth = side chip / Z; the ramp reads the chip at the shipped RPM; ramp feed = min(cut feed, axial chip x RPM x Z / tan θ); tan θ is conservative against sin θ

entries.headline: Ramp feed 6096 mm/min: the cut feed (chip limit 58159 mm/min at ramp 3.00°)
entries.detail: axial chip 0.0635 mm/tooth x 24000 RPM x 2 flutes = 3048 mm/min vertical; / tan 3.00° (0.05241) = chip limit 58159 mm/min; cut feed 6096 mm/min; the G6 vertical rate is 3048 mm/min and the plunge (feed / Z, ruling Q4) is 2500 mm/min; the two agree only at depth tier 1; the machine Z axis rate ($112) caps the vertical rate at 2500 mm/min; the entry is from the Adaptive3d entry; θ is the configured slope; vendor row, plunge claim (G6 drill): the side chip of the pocket row / 2 flutes (x0.50); row amana-flat-hardwood-pocket-6000-2f-spektra (amana_spektra_spiral_plunge_v24); Amana prints Ramp Down = feed rate / flutes at one RPM: axial chip per tooth = side chip / Z; the ramp reads the chip at the shipped RPM; ramp feed = min(cut feed, axial chip x RPM x Z / tan θ); tan θ is conservative against sin θ; Ramp angle 3.00°: operator value (the rule for hardwood: 5.00°, Easel); Entry starts 0.50 mm above the material: no source; operator rule 0.5 mm

plunge.headline: Plunge: no source; repo rule material base 240 mm/min, tip cap 300 mm/min, Z axis rate 2500 mm/min (tapered ball nose 2.0 mm is outside tip 0.5-1.5875 mm)
plunge.detail: The rule: material base 1000/h (wood), 900/h (plywood, sheet) at 6 mm, x clamp(D/6, 0.25, 3), h = (Janka/600)^0.4 (a port of the Shapeoko reference calculator). The tapered ball nose rule g10_plunge_tapered covers tip 0.5-1.5875 mm only; this tool is 2.0 mm. The tip cap 300 mm/min at a tip of 2.0 mm: no stored source; repo rule 150 mm/min per mm of tip (a code comment cites FSWizard / GWizard 100-300 mm/min; not stored). The vertical rate: the machine Z axis rate ($112) caps the vertical rate at 2500 mm/min. The engine does not read the cut direction: a down-cut or compression tool must ramp, not plunge (Vortex, AXYZ, grade c; ruling Q12, future work).

ramp.headline: ramp chip: none; the ramp holds its vertical rate at the plunge
ramp.detail: No G6 drill claim covers a 2 mm 2-flute tapered ball nose (the claim covers the Amana Spektra flat end mill, 3.0-12.7 mm, 2 or 3 flutes, in wood, plywood and MDF), so the ramp holds its vertical rate at the plunge.

plunge.headline: Plunge = min(feed / 2, 0.0635 x rpm x 2, Z axis rate 2500 mm/min) (G10 plunge claim: flat end mill, Amana Spektra rule; Sienci, IDC, 3.0-12.7 mm, 2-3 flutes)
plunge.detail: plunge = fraction x shipped side feed; the fraction is the printed plunge / feed of the family; rule g10_plunge_flat (rulings Q4 and Q5, 2026-09-25): x0.500 at 2 flutes; witnesses: Amana Spektra Spiral Plunge chart v24 rule and cells (Ramp Down = feed / flutes; the G6-verified cells set the range); Sienci metric chart, 60 flat rows at 0.500-0.505; IDC Woodcraft up-cut 1/8 and 1/4 in at 0.50; Carbide 3D S3 chart, median 0.49; statements g10-wood-amana-spektra-rule, g10-wood-amana-spektra-2f-quarter, g10-wood-amana-spektra-3f-quarter, g10-wood-amana-spektra-3f-3-4, g10-hobby-036..038, g10-hobby-040..042, g10-hobby-044..047, g10-hobby-051..053, g10-hobby-055..057, g10-hobby-059..062, g10-hobby-066..068, g10-hobby-070..072, g10-hobby-074..077, g10-hobby-089..091, g10-hobby-093..095, g10-hobby-097..100, g10-hobby-104..106, g10-hobby-108..110, g10-hobby-112..115, g10-hobby-119..121, g10-hobby-123..125, g10-hobby-127..130, g10-wood-idc-up-eighth, g10-wood-idc-up-quarter, g10-hobby-134..138; spread: IDC down-cut 0.30 and 0.43 (g10-wood-idc-down-eighth, g10-wood-idc-down-quarter); Carbide 3D Nomad 0.24-0.44 (g10-hobby-139..143); valid 3.0-12.7 mm, 2-3 flutes, in softwood, hardwood, plywood and MDF; two or more witnesses; Amana Ramp Down is the vertical (Z) rate (ruling Q3); ruling Q4 reads it as feed / Z; vertical rate: G6 axial chip 0.0635 mm/tooth x rpm x 2 (row amana-flat-hardwood-pocket-6000-2f-spektra); the machine Z axis rate ($112) caps the vertical rate at 2500 mm/min. The engine does not read the cut direction: a down-cut or compression tool must ramp, not plunge (Vortex, AXYZ, grade c; ruling Q12, future work).

ramp.headline: ramp chip (G6 drill claim): 0.0635 mm/tooth axial
ramp.detail: vendor row, plunge claim (G6 drill): the side chip of the pocket row / 2 flutes (x0.50); row amana-flat-hardwood-pocket-6000-2f-spektra (amana_spektra_spiral_plunge_v24); Amana prints Ramp Down = feed rate / flutes at one RPM: axial chip per tooth = side chip / Z; the ramp reads the chip at the shipped RPM; ramp feed = min(cut feed, axial chip x RPM x Z / tan θ); tan θ is conservative against sin θ

entries.headline: Ramp feed 7161 mm/min: the cut feed (chip limit 58159 mm/min at ramp 3.00°)
entries.detail: axial chip 0.0635 mm/tooth x 24000 RPM x 2 flutes = 3048 mm/min vertical; / tan 3.00° (0.05241) = chip limit 58159 mm/min; cut feed 7161 mm/min; the G6 vertical rate is 3048 mm/min and the plunge (feed / Z, ruling Q4) is 2500 mm/min; the two agree only at depth tier 1; the machine Z axis rate ($112) caps the vertical rate at 2500 mm/min; the entry is from the toolpath's entry dressup; θ is the configured slope; vendor row, plunge claim (G6 drill): the side chip of the pocket row / 2 flutes (x0.50); row amana-flat-hardwood-pocket-6000-2f-spektra (amana_spektra_spiral_plunge_v24); Amana prints Ramp Down = feed rate / flutes at one RPM: axial chip per tooth = side chip / Z; the ramp reads the chip at the shipped RPM; ramp feed = min(cut feed, axial chip x RPM x Z / tan θ); tan θ is conservative against sin θ; Ramp angle 3.00°: operator value (the rule for hardwood: 5.00°, Easel); Entry starts 0.50 mm above the material: no source; operator rule 0.5 mm
